scope: Repeat x86/x64 interface and main-workflow audit; repair updates when bundled components or the updater are missing.
fixes: Detect incomplete installed components, including missing sidecar DLLs, wrappers, licences and inconsistent 7-Zip versions.
Offer verified full-package repair even when the application version is current; stage application first and use its runtime to prepare component downloads without modifying installed files.
Use the matching updater from the verified application archive; reject modified helpers, payload metadata or archive hashes.
Recheck before restart if a cached component job loses its installed updater; preserve recovery jobs.
Keep healthy independently installed newer components; repair incomplete newer distributions as a whole.
Keep independent component downloads available when the application release has no installable archive, and retain visible source error details.
Cache installed inventory, avoid repeated foreground activation and unchanged row updates; reuse release-note controls and cached text layout.
Render native book-information group captions readably in the dark theme on both architectures, retaining native item selection and accessibility.

performance.interpretation: Local fixture measurements; they are not universal user-machine speed guarantees or a controlled before/after ratio.

failed_attempt_notes: Keyboard accessibility initially failed because the test fixture could not acquire foreground focus; both architectures passed with the actual fixture window activated, without weakening the keyboard assertion.

An experimental off-screen pixel assertion for native group headers did not reproduce Windows painting reliably; it was removed. Its failed logs are retained. Real final application windows were visually confirmed on both architectures and the original functional book-information regression passed.

The first newer-version fixture patched an unrelated executable byte signature and failed its fixture assertion; the driver was corrected to locate VS_VERSION_INFO and both complete/incomplete preservation cases passed on both architectures.
Earlier failed or stale test attempts remain in the ignored raw evidence directory and are excluded from passing counts.

limits: This is sampled visual inspection alongside the broad native regression matrix, not a claim that every dialog was manually exercised.
Manual note text entry/save and export completion were not established: tool focus returned to the owner window; those behaviors are covered by native regressions.
Live updater component selection/zoom was not established manually because targeting the modeless window returned focus to its owner; automated keyboard/layout/theme/DPI tests cover it.
The live remote component check was closed while pending, so this manual step does not certify the current availability of every author site.

evidence_policy: Raw logs, private portable runtimes, downloaded archives and test executables remain local ignored files. This report retains their paths and hashes; the report alone does not embed every raw log.
release_state: Development fixes on top of pre5.24/build 1092. Version was not incremented and the published pre5.24 release/assets were not replaced during this audit.
limitations: Automated installation/rollback tests used isolated synthetic personal data, not the user library.
A successful audited workflow is not proof that no undiscovered defect exists in every possible configuration.
Live author endpoints and installations on other Windows versions were not exhaustively certified.
